title: Puppy reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- puppy body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#e0a955'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='19' fill='#f2c078'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='30' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#c98a3f' transform='rotate(-20 32 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='30' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#c98a3f' transform='rotate(20 68 30)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#fbe3c0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='3' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='3' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='39' r='1' fill='#fffbe8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='39' r='1' fill='#fffbe8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='3.5' ry='2.6' fill='#5a3a22'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#e86a7a'/>
  <!-- paws holding book -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='74' r='5' fill='#f2c078'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='74' r='5' fill='#f2c078'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x='26' y='68' width='48' height='24' rx='3' fill='#5fc4d6'/>
  <rect x='26' y='68' width='48' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8fe0ee'/>
  <rect x='48' y='70' width='4' height='20' fill='#3a9aad'/>
  <!-- pages lines -->
  <line x1='33' y1='78' x2='44' y2='78' stroke='#fffbe8' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='83' x2='44' y2='83' stroke='#fffbe8' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='78' x2='67' y2='78' stroke='#fffbe8' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='83' x2='67' y2='83' stroke='#fffbe8' stroke-width='1.6'/>
</svg>
